welcome.title: Welcome to VibeSmith!
welcome.description: Manage Skills, Agents, Commands, Hooks, and Rules in one place. Take a 2-minute tour to explore the key features!

scan.title: Scan Your Project
scan.description: Click the Settings button to add your first project. VibeSmith will scan your project folder for AI agent components.

components.title: Browse Components
components.description: View all AI agent components in one place. Filter by type, project, and status.

create.title: Create a New Skill
create.description: Use the Wizard to create new Skills, Agents, and Commands with guided templates.

projects.title: Open the Project Hub
projects.description: Use the Projects tab for list and sync actions, and check usage insights under Components > Analysis.

graph.title: Explore the Dependency Graph
graph.description: Visually explore the relationships between components in the dependency graph. Identify circular dependencies and impact scope at a glance.
